Using Mary Meeker’s AI Trends Report, we look at why India is emerging as the AI use-case capital of the world, even though it isn’t building trillion-dollar foundation models like the US or Europe.
This isn’t a futuristic take. It’s a data-backed breakdown of how Indians are using AI at scale today.
In this breakdown, we cover:
• Why India leads the world in AI usage, not AI models
• What “AI use-case capital” really means
• How government initiatives like IndiaAI are shaping adoption
• Why global AI companies are doubling down on India
